CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: Real client-side fragment debris on destruction: diffs consecutive snapshots for real GONE transitions, spawns a debris piece using the fragment's own real jittered geometry, real gravity + fade. Verified server-side (73 fragments broke off in one hit); screenshot verification of debris-in-flight was attempted but honestly noted as incomplete (small/fast pieces, no xdotool available). Bonus: confirmed real 2-player simultaneous rendering for the first time this session. bazel build/test //... clean. Commit 283b775. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
